tools.name: design_handoff
tools.description: Open a Cue Design project from chat with the user's brief and the Cue brand already loaded, and return a link that drops them straight into the studio. Use this for design-PROJECT work the studio is built for — a slide deck / pitch deck, a landing or marketing page, a UI prototype or screen flow, a dashboard mockup, a poster/flyer/one-pager, or any multi-artboard visual layout the user will refine visually. It creates the project on the Cue Design sidecar with `brief` pre-loaded into the composer (one click to generate) and the Cue design system attached. Do NOT use it for deterministic motion-graphics video (use hyperframes_render), for AI-generated footage (use video-studio), or for design-quality frontend CODE inside a repo (use frontend-design). After calling, give the user the returned open link.

title.description: Short project title (e.g. "Raise Pitch Deck", "Halo Landing Page"). Shown as the project name in Cue Design.

brief.description: The full design request to pre-load into the studio composer: what to make, for whom, the key content/sections, and any style direction. Write it as the prompt the user would type — concrete and specific (include real facts from the conversation). Default the brand to the Cue design system unless the user asked for another style.
